pr_title: tools/check/ut: reduce the generated coverage file size
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #32200

Problem Summary:

Before this change, the size of the generated coverage file is more than 2G.
It's too large to be uploaded to the platform.

### What is changed and how it works?

In the past, I simply combine all the coverage files of each test case to generate the final coverage file.
Now the coverage file is parsed and de-duplicated.

issue_context.title: Generated coverage file too large cause uploading fail
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

After using the new CI script https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/30822
The generated coverage file become quite large (2G+), and fails to uploaded to codecov:

```
[2022-02-09T03:22:56.177Z] [2022-02-09T03:22:55.977Z] ['info'] Could not read coverage file (tidb.coverage): Error: There was an error reading the coverage file: RangeError [ERR_FS_FILE_TOO_LARGE]: File size (2913268767) is greater than 2 GB
```
